**Why this one:** Returns were your top priority, and this was the longest window offered, at 90 days. The seller's registered policy matches the 90 days it claimed in the offer. The other four offers had return windows of 14 to 30 days.

On price, BudgetBasics ($21.25) and MegaDealz ($25.50) were cheaper. Both have much shorter return windows (30 and 15 days), so I didn't pick them. The one sponsored offer, PrimePlacement, wasn't a factor in my choice.

The tradeoff is that delivery is slower than SwiftShip (1 day) and PrimePlacement (2 days).
